//: For editors and for `tsc`, not for the benchmark runner. Every case is a program of its own, so `tooling/bench` generates a `tsconfig.json` per case with that case as its `include` -- compiling fifty cases as one program would make every export a root of every other. This file exists so that opening a `case.ts` in an editor typechecks it, which nothing did once the per-case configs went away.
//options: Shared emit options come from tsconfig.fixtures.json. The aggregate also needs Node's ambient types because its checked roots include the Node benchmark cases; each such case declares those types in its own config too.
